svg.title: How NovaFabric works, end to end
svg.desc: The whole system on one map. A workload runs under nova capture or a framework adapter; its SDK calls are intercepted, secret-scanned and written into a Run Capsule, which is optionally sealed and then indexed for lineage. The capsule is replayed, diffed in CI, verified and exported as an Evidence Bundle. nova serve, OTLP ingest and nova server work on the same capsules. Step 1: nova capture runs your command as a child process; the runner puts a sitecustomize hook loader on its PYTHONPATH. Step 2: Or capture in-process: a framework adapter, or the sdk agent decorator, writes its own capsule with capture_mode sdk-decorator. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 3: In the child, install_all patches the OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs: sync, async, streamed and Responses API calls each become one record. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 4: The httpx hook also records each HTTP attempt. Under an SDK call it is marked transport and linked by logical_call_id (ADR-0305). (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 5: When the workload exits, env.lock is written with the measured host block; then SecretScannerV0 redacts matches in place. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 6: If events were dropped, capture-health.json is written first, so the residual secret pass rescans it and the digests bind it. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 7: replay.yaml, lineage.jsonl and capsule.yaml are written; evidence_digests pins a SHA-256 and size for every evidence file. Step 8: If NovaSeal is configured, the canonical manifest is signed into a DSSE envelope; a sealing failure only warns, never fails capture. Step 9: The seal is appended to a SHA-256 Merkle log; an RFC 3161 token is requested only from a tsa_url you configure. Step 10: lineage.jsonl edges are indexed into the local SQLite lineage store; assets are versioned as name@version in the registry. Step 11: nova replay re-runs the command (mocked, the default) and serves recorded model calls per API surface, sync, async or streamed. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 12: A recorded rate limit or 5xx is raised again as the SDK's own exception class; transport attempts are never served. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 13: intervention substitutes one event and writes a counterfactual capsule; it records whether the substitute reached the workload. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 14: nova diff A B pairs logical model calls, tool calls and outputs/; a provider or request-parameter change is a changed call. (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 15: With --assert-no-regressions: exit 0 no difference, 1 a difference, 2 could not compare (bad ref, malformed capsule file or lines). (on main, unreleased (after v0.104.0).) Step 16: nova verify checks signature, timestamp, Merkle inclusion, manifest binding and every file digest; one changed byte exits 1. Step 17: nova export-evidence packs the capsule, a lineage subgraph and Ed25519-signed in-toto attestations into one ZIP. Step 18: nova serve is a localhost dashboard and API over your capsules: a Host guard, a token, and a scope on every route. Step 19: OTLP traces carrying gen_ai.* spans become a brand-new capsule; OTLP logs go to an append-only sidecar, never into a capsule. Step 20: nova server is the team REST API (/v0): API keys with workspace binding, budgets and keyset pages, on SQLite or Postgres. Step 21: Planned: mocked replay substitutes non-MCP tool results on owned boundaries (ADR-0306, proposed). Today those tools run live. Step 22: Future design: re-running a framework-adapter capsule, and multi-cluster federation of capsules and lineage. Not implemented.
svg.text: How NovaFabric works, end to end
Capture → Run Capsule → seal → registry and lineage → replay → diff gate → verify → Evidence Bundle, plus server mode
nova capture runs your command as a child process; the runner puts a sitecustomize hook loader on its PYTHONPATH.
Or capture in-process: a framework adapter, or the sdk agent decorator, writes its own capsule with capture_mode sdk-decorator.
In the child, install_all patches the OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs: sync, async, streamed and Responses API calls each become one record.
The httpx hook also records each HTTP attempt. Under an SDK call it is marked transport and linked by logical_call_id (ADR-0305).
When the workload exits, env.lock is written with the measured host block; then SecretScannerV0 redacts matches in place.
If events were dropped, capture-health.json is written first, so the residual secret pass rescans it and the digests bind it.
replay.yaml, lineage.jsonl and capsule.yaml are written; evidence_digests pins a SHA-256 and size for every evidence file.
If NovaSeal is configured, the canonical manifest is signed into a DSSE envelope; a sealing failure only warns, never fails capture.
The seal is appended to a SHA-256 Merkle log; an RFC 3161 token is requested only from a tsa_url you configure.
lineage.jsonl edges are indexed into the local SQLite lineage store; assets are versioned as name@version in the registry.
nova replay re-runs the command (mocked, the default) and serves recorded model calls per API surface, sync, async or streamed.
A recorded rate limit or 5xx is raised again as the SDK's own exception class; transport attempts are never served.
intervention substitutes one event and writes a counterfactual capsule; it records whether the substitute reached the workload.
nova diff A B pairs logical model calls, tool calls and outputs/; a provider or request-parameter change is a changed call.
With --assert-no-regressions: exit 0 no difference, 1 a difference, 2 could not compare (bad ref, malformed capsule file or lines).
nova verify checks signature, timestamp, Merkle inclusion, manifest binding and every file digest; one changed byte exits 1.
nova export-evidence packs the capsule, a lineage subgraph and Ed25519-signed in-toto attestations into one ZIP.
nova serve is a localhost dashboard and API over your capsules: a Host guard, a token, and a scope on every route.
OTLP traces carrying gen_ai.* spans become a brand-new capsule; OTLP logs go to an append-only sidecar, never into a capsule.
nova server is the team REST API (/v0): API keys with workspace binding, budgets and keyset pages, on SQLite or Postgres.
Planned: mocked replay substitutes non-MCP tool results on owned boundaries (ADR-0306, proposed). Today those tools run live.
Future design: re-running a framework-adapter capsule, and multi-cluster federation of capsules and lineage. Not implemented.
